description: Introduction and overview of the Lancia Stratos (1973-1978): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Lancia Stratos was the first car designed from scratch for rallying, with a Ferrari Dino V6 amidships and a wedge shape by Bertone. It won the World Rally Championship three straight years (1974-76). Only 492 road cars were built for homologation, making it a legend.
